# Zero UIV Retro Expansion Panel

A highly customizable, Uiverse-inspired Retro accordion component for Lit.

## Features

- ✅ Boxy grid design with hard shadows
- ✅ Yellowed header area with high-contrast borders
- ✅ Simple [+][-] state indicator
- ✅ Pure CSS (No Tailwind)
- ✅ Fully customizable via RendererAttributes (Title)
- ✅ ADA Compliant

## Installation

```html
<script src="path/to/zero-uiv-expansion-retro.js" type="module"></script>
```

## Usage

```html
<zero-uiv-expansion-retro title="CONFIG.SYS">
    <pre>DEVICE=C:\DOS\HIMEM.SYS
FILES=30</pre>
</zero-uiv-expansion-retro>
```

## CSS Variables

- `--uiv-retro-border`: Border and shadow color
- `--uiv-retro-bg`: Main background color
- `--uiv-retro-accent`: Header area color
